current_disposition.reason: No public v4.1 artifacts, baseline reports, seed-panel sensitivity analysis, or feasibility evidence exist. The equality 0.750000 + 0.050000 = 0.800000 supplies no confidence-bound margin.

prerequisites_before_calibration: An accepted successor must replace the per-sequence baseline-conditioned rejection with one complete-artifact check after deterministic generation.

Every calibration seed pair must be fixed before generation by a public IID randomness procedure and published with its source record; convenient SHA-256 literal strings alone are reproducible but not an IID sample.
The v4.1 generator, constraints, baseline implementations, canonical artifact format, and report schema must be versioned and digest-bound before the first pair is generated.
A failed artifact, baseline result, retry, crash, or missing report is disclosed and fails the calibration; it never causes resampling or replacement of a seed.

public_calibration.seed_pair_independence: IID uniform 256-bit public seeds, independently committed for train and development before generation
public_calibration.metric: sequence_classification_accuracy = correct_count / sequence_count as an exact rational; display rounding to six decimal places is non-decisive
public_calibration.selection: Only train labels may select a parameterized baseline. The selected canonical parameter tuple is immutable before its paired development score.

aggregation.per_baseline: report the exact development accuracy for each seed pair plus median, IQR, and maximum
aggregation.ceiling_statistic: C_panel = max over all required baselines and all 132 paired-development accuracies
aggregation.coverage: For eight required baselines and IID seed pairs, the observed maximum covers each baseline's 95th generator quantile simultaneously with at least 1 - 8*(0.95^132) = 0.9908 design-based coverage. This is a tolerance guarantee, not a hidden-evaluation result.

required_baselines.majority_class: Predict the public-train majority label; a tie predicts positive.
required_baselines.seeded_random: For each sequence, use the committed baseline-random HMAC stream and predict positive exactly when draw(..., 2) equals 1.
required_baselines.stateless_last_observation: Predict positive exactly when the final first feature is non-negative.
required_baselines.uniform_pooling: Predict positive exactly when the arithmetic sum of all first-feature micro-units is non-negative.
required_baselines.non_neural_finite_state: Start q at 0; add +1, -1, or 0 for each first-feature sign; clamp q to [-3, 3]; predict positive when q is non-negative.
required_baselines.parameter_matched_stateless: Select only on paired public train from canonical tuples (b, w_last, w_sum, w_second) in {-2,-1,0,1,2}^4; predict positive when b*1000000 + w_last*final_first_feature + w_sum*sum_first_feature + w_second*sum_second_feature is non-negative. It has no recurrent state.
required_baselines.public_generator_family_heuristic: Select only on paired public train a decay d in {0,250000,500000,750000,1000000}. Start a at 0 and update a to round-half-away-from-zero((d*a + 1000000*first_feature_t)/1000000) at each step; predict positive when a is non-negative. It has no access to latent state, labels, seed, or generator internals.
required_baselines.parameter_matched_recurrent_non_neural: Select only on paired public train from canonical tuples (b, w_first, w_second, r) in {-2,-1,0,1,2}^4. Start h at 0; at each step set h to clamp(r*h + b*1000000 + w_first*first_feature + w_second*second_feature, -8000000, 8000000); predict positive when h is non-negative. It has no trainable feature gate, neural activation, or access to latent fields.

adopt_only_if: C_panel is less than or equal to 0.700000 and every seed pair has complete public artifact, constraint, baseline, and attempt-ledger digests.
The eight-baseline panel is complete; no development result was used for selection; no seed, artifact, or failed attempt was replaced.

A preregistered public paired-bootstrap sensitivity analysis at hidden minimum n=2048 demonstrates one-sided family-wise 95% lower-bound power of at least 0.90 for a full-model accuracy of 0.800000 against each allowed ceiling across all declared discordance/correlation bands.
The analysis resamples sequences with a digest-derived counter RNG, fixes the quantile convention and at least 10000 replicates, and reselects the strongest baseline within each replicate.
ceiling_decision_rule.otherwise: Reject the v4.1 generator/constraint policy and preregister a successor. Do not raise the ceiling, tune against development, or infer feasibility from this package.

sensitivity_bands.assessment: only admissible if the fixed-seed panel supports it; do not force it by rejection sampling
requires the same complete panel and power evidence
largest proposed admissible ceiling; leaves twice the inherited 0.050000 lift threshold before confidence uncertainty
not admissible without stronger replacement evidence; family-wise confidence margin can consume the remaining lift
rejected: it equals the inherited lower-confidence-bound lift and leaves no uncertainty margin

future_hidden_scoring_precision.comparators: full minus each required baseline and full minus each declared ablation
future_hidden_scoring_precision.family_wise_method: one-sided 95% lower confidence bound for the minimum comparator lift, using a digest-derived counter RNG and at least 10000 paired nonparametric bootstrap replicates
future_hidden_scoring_precision.strongest_baseline_control: reselect the maximum baseline score inside every bootstrap replicate
future_hidden_scoring_precision.failure_rule: Any missing, non-finite, malformed, out-of-band, post-commitment, overlapped, retried, unsigned, or incompletely disclosed result fails closed.

claim_boundary: This rule rejects an unsupported number and defines only conditions for a later public calibration. It does not prove the recurrent candidate can attain 0.800000, create a candidate, pass a gate, or authorize NB-2. The power requirement prevents the ceiling itself from making the inherited threshold statistically incoherent; candidate feasibility remains unknown until a separately authorized public-only package supplies it.
